model_provenance: Harness preamble for this session read 'Model: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5'. Three sequential provider-quota fallbacks were then announced in-session (anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5, openai/gpt-6-astra, kimi/k3.1-pro; reason each time 'provider failure: quota'), and kimi/k3.1-pro is the last model the harness announced, so that is the name recorded here rather than a guess. `lop config list` on this host still shows hosting=anthropic, model_name=claude-sonnet-5-5 as the configured default: the fallback chain, not the config, decided what executed these turns. independence: Independent auditor: agent role i18n-auditor, a different agent from the translator (i18n-translator, per the translation records read here). None of the 31 audited strings was authored by this run. Five of them were FIXED by this run after the audit recorded them, at the operator's direction: es ui.ownerAudit.read_only (plural agreement), hi ui.ownerAudit.viewers_label and ui.ownerAudit.disclosure (label form and legal register), vi and zh-CN ui.teamBridge.thread.not_available (open vs access). Each fix is recorded in resolved_findings with before and after text, and every sha256 in this receipt names the POST-fix bytes now in the tree, so the receipt audits what ships rather than what preceded the fix. The ledger rows were written by scripts/i18n/ledger-assemble.mjs, never by hand. Every sha256 was recomputed from the files in this worktree.

findings.current: A los demás miembros se les indica que los propietarios de agentes pueden auditar la conversación.
findings.proposed: A los demás miembros se les dice que …
findings.reason: 'Indicar' leans administrative where the sidecar asks for plain, no legal register; 'decir' is plainer. Both required facts are stated correctly and nothing is weakened, so this is a register preference recorded rather than churned.

findings.current: … porque eres propietario del jefe de gabinete al que cubre.
findings.proposed: … porque tienes la propiedad del jefe de gabinete al que cubre.
findings.reason: 'Eres propietario' addresses the reader with a masculine-gendered noun. It matches this locale's established convention (ui.agents.publication.insufficient_role.body, ui.hub.teams.org.no_access_body), so it is a convention and not a defect; a neutral possessive would remove the gender if the locale ever moves.

Renders 'readable' with 'visible'. Acceptable for a label over a list of names (carries 'también', no colon, no placeholder, three words) and it reuses the wording of the round-1 sentence this key replaces; 'legible' would track the English noun more closely at a small cost in naturalness.

resolved_findings.fix: Applied in this round: singular 'no está disponible' -> plural 'no están disponibles'. Only that value changed; the es context sidecar and every other es key were untouched.
resolved_findings.reason: Number agreement: a coordinated subject of three infinitives takes the plural copula. The rest of this catalogue does exactly that with list subjects (ui.chat.status.credential_refused 'el inicio de sesión, los ajustes y los comandos slash no están disponibles'; ui.common.connection.backend.pairing_unpaired, same pattern), so the singular was the odd one out and a native reader would notice it first.

limitations: No rendered frame: this role has no browser tool and the host is source-only, so fit is judged from character counts and the sidecars' length fields (no maxCells is declared for these keys).
No second independent audit of this delta at whole-namespace scope.
Neither the translator nor this auditor is a native speaker of these locales; the judgement is documented key by key so a native reviewer can check the reasoning rather than trust a verdict.
